parsed_json.up: Select compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Start from molecule_dictionary for CHEMBL1422 as parent. Use molecule_hierarchy to include the parent row and all child salts (parent_molregno = parent.molregno). Join compound_records on molregno, then activities on record_id, then docs on doc_id, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter activities to standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and target chembl_id CHEMBL284. Derive pubmed_id_or_doi preferring pubmed_id over doi from docs. Derive target_chembl_id from target_dictionary.chembl_id, target_name from pref_name, target_organism from organism. Sort by all output columns. No row limit.
